title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Frontend - Sênior
description:
Esperamos que você:

  • Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
  • Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
  • Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source.


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar com migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
  • Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads.


Requisitos

  • Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
  • Vivência com monorepos (ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
  • Experiência com testes unitários e end-to-end;
  • Conhecimento em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG).


Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Experiência em atuar com Design System e Design Tokens;
  • Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
  • Implementação e manutenção de Storybook;
  • Testes de regressão visual;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
  • Colaboração direta com designers, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
  • Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência.


Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4HANA.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

Health insurance

Dental Plan

title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4HANA.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

  • Projetar e evoluir sistemas com foco em automação , direcionados à eficiência operacional do grupo SBF;
  • Garantir funcionalidade, manutenibilidade, escalabilidade e qualidade , aplicando boas práticas de engenharia e testes;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, com pair programming, feedbacks contínuos e cultura de alta performance .


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo

  • Proficiência avançada em Python (orientação a objetos, concorrência, boas práticas de código);
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes para implantação escalável de modelos e serviços;
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento aplicados a sistemas de IA e automação;
  • Sólida prática em testes unitários, integração e validação de modelos;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo , com autonomia;
  • Embasamento teórico em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina e boas práticas de engenharia de software (DDD, design de código, paradigmas);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Seria legal se você conhecesse

  • Google Cloud AI/ML Services (Vertex AI, AI Platform);
  • Continuous Integration & Delivery aplicados a ML (CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos);
  • Ferramentas de processamento de dados em streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub);
  • Boas práticas de DataOps e integração com times de dados e automação.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Analista Tributário Jr
description:
Já pensou em Somar no CSC de um dos maiores grupos empresariais do Brasil?

Somos o UltraCSC+, um Centro de Soluções Compartilhadas criado para facilitar a gestão do dia a dia das empresas do Grupo Ultra, promovendo mais eficiência e produtividade em processos transacionais.


Você soma com nosso crescimento!

Aqui você é o protagonista da transformação que queremos. A sua paixão, senso de dono, responsabilidade e inconformismo são os combustíveis para chegarmos mais longe.


E sobre a vaga?

Atuará na gestão da regularidade fiscal das empresas, bem como, no atendimento aos questionamentos e solicitações de informações efetuadas pelo fisco.


Você focará em:

  • Analisar e revisar obrigações acessórias (DCTF, ECF, EFD, etc);
  • Analisar documentos fiscais, livros contábeis e documentos gerenciais necessários para atendimento de procedimentos fiscalizatórios;
  • Preparar parecer técnico tributário / fiscal, bem como book de documentos que o embase a análise;
  • Identificar eventuais riscos fiscais e propor eventuais soluções;
  • Apoiar na renovação, aquisição e controle de certificados digitais;
  • Renovar as certidões tributárias federais e dar as devidas tratativas para eventuais pendências que impeçam a renovação automática das certidões;
  • Leitura das caixas postais eletrônicas disponíveis no e-CAC;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes internas, como contabilidade, tributária e jurídico
  • Realizar conciliação de depósitos judiciais;
  • Analisar e realizar movimentações contábeis relativas as provisões jurídicas, bem com seus impactos nos resultados operacionais e financeiros;
  • Acompanhar e realizar análises comparativas das contingências possíveis e remotas.


Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:

  • Superior completo em Contábeis e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento básico de legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipais;
  • Conhecimento na confecção e retificações de obrigações acessórias;
  • Experiência com e-CAC e suas funcionalidades;
  • Conhecimento básico em contabilidade (compreensão e aplicabilidade dos princípios contábeis);
  • Boa comunicação e redação.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior (Python)
description:
O seu papel como Software Engineer Senior (E3)

  • Desenvolver soluções de ponta a ponta em Python , desde a definição de arquitetura até testes e rollout em produção;
  • Projetar e evoluir sistemas com foco em automação , direcionados à eficiência operacional do grupo SBF;
  • Garantir funcionalidade, manutenibilidade, escalabilidade e qualidade , aplicando boas práticas de engenharia e testes;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, com pair programming, feedbacks contínuos e cultura de alta performance .


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo

  • Proficiência avançada em Python (orientação a objetos, concorrência, boas práticas de código);
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes para implantação escalável de modelos e serviços;
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento aplicados a sistemas de IA e automação;
  • Sólida prática em testes unitários, integração e validação de modelos;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo , com autonomia;
  • Embasamento teórico em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina e boas práticas de engenharia de software (DDD, design de código, paradigmas);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Seria legal se você conhecesse

  • Google Cloud AI/ML Services (Vertex AI, AI Platform);
  • Continuous Integration & Delivery aplicados a ML (CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos);
  • Ferramentas de processamento de dados em streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub);
  • Boas práticas de DataOps e integração com times de dados e automação.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

description:

English fluently

Excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-disciplinary research environment.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

title: Gen AI Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

English fluently

Proven 2+ end-to-end MCP-based agent orchestration implementations.

Strong expertise in Python, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, or similar frameworks.

Experienced Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy scalable multi-agent systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP)

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years as an AI Engineer delivering multiple production-grade AI solutions, and at least 2 complete end-to-end AI/MCP-based orchestration projects, including knowledge of benchmarking and guardrails.


You will lead the design and integration of LLM-driven agents, build modular toolchains, and ensure seamless orchestration across enterprise-grade research applications.


Solid understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), API integration, and LLM orchestration.


Experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and monitoring AI pipelines.


Excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-disciplinary research environment.


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.

    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Linguagem de Programação: Python, SQL, Scala, Pyspark, Shell Script. Fundamentos: DataMesh, Database SQL e NoSQL, Hadoop Ecossistema, Engenharia de Software, Privacidade e Segurança. Arquitetura de Dados: ETL vs ELT, Modelagem tradicional, Dimensional e Hibrido, Estruturado / Não Estruturado, Camada de Dados Brutos (SOR), Camada de Dados Harmonizados (SOT), Camada de Dados Especializados (SPEC), Data Analytics, Data Viz, Data Storytelling. Experiencia com processamento distribuído e de grandes volumes de dados.   • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;

title: Vendedor
description:
Vaga para Vendedora em Clínica de Transplante Capilar

Você é apaixonada por vendas e deseja atuar em um mercado em crescimento? Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Estamos em busca de uma vendedora dedicada para integrar nossa clínica especializada em transplante capilar. Se você tem facilidade de comunicação, gosta de desafios e está em busca de uma oportunidade que valorize seu potencial, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades:

- Atendimento ao cliente, fornecendo informações detalhadas sobre os serviços de transplante capilar.

- Prospecção de novos clientes e manutenção de um bom relacionamento com os já existentes.

- Acompanhamento de todas as etapas do processo de vendas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.

- Fechamento de vendas e acompanhamento pós-venda.

- Cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela equipe de vendas.


Requisitos:

- Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente no ramo da saúde ou estética.

- Habilidade de comunicação e persuasão.

- Foco em resultados e superação de metas.

- Proatividade, organização e comprometimento.


O que oferecemos:

- *Salário fixo*  compatível com o mercado.

- *Comissão atrativa *:

- *Vale transporte* e *vale alimentação*.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e de fácil acesso.

- Oportunidade de crescimento dentro da empresa.

Horário de trabalho:

Segunda a sexta-feira das 9h às 18h

Sábado das 9h às 13h

Se você está pronta para se juntar a um time vencedor e ajudar nossos clientes a alcançarem os resultados dos sonhos, envie seu currículo e venha conquistar grandes resultados com a gente!

*Vem ser nossa estrela!*

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS Pleno/Sênior - ID 123360
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Linguagem de Programação: Python, SQL, Scala, Pyspark, Shell Script. Fundamentos: DataMesh, Database SQL e NoSQL, Hadoop Ecossistema, Engenharia de Software, Privacidade e Segurança. Engenharia de Dados: Data Ingestion, Data Stream, PRocessamento Paralelo, Processamento Massivo. Arquitetura de Dados: ETL vs ELT, Modelagem tradicional, Dimensional e Hibrido, Estruturado / Não Estruturado, Camada de Dados Brutos (SOR), Camada de Dados Harmonizados (SOT), Camada de Dados Especializados (SPEC), Data Analytics, Data Viz, Data Storytelling. Experiencia com processamento distribuído e de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência em Pipelines CI/CD (codepipeline / githubactions); Conhecimento nos serviços primários da AWS (Storage Gateway, Direct Connect, DMS, Lambda, Glue, RDS, API Gateway)


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Vendedor
description:
Vaga para Vendedora em Clínica de Transplante Capilar

Você é apaixonada por vendas e deseja atuar em um mercado em crescimento? Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Estamos em busca de uma vendedora dedicada para integrar nossa clínica especializada em transplante capilar. Se você tem facilidade de comunicação, gosta de desafios e está em busca de uma oportunidade que valorize seu potencial, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades:

- Atendimento ao cliente, fornecendo informações detalhadas sobre os serviços de transplante capilar.

- Prospecção de novos clientes e manutenção de um bom relacionamento com os já existentes.

- Acompanhamento de todas as etapas do processo de vendas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.

- Fechamento de vendas e acompanhamento pós-venda.

- Cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela equipe de vendas.


Requisitos:

- Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente no ramo da saúde ou estética.

- Habilidade de comunicação e persuasão.

- Foco em resultados e superação de metas.

- Proatividade, organização e comprometimento.


O que oferecemos:

- *Salário fixo*  compatível com o mercado.

- *Comissão atrativa *:

- *Vale transporte* e *vale alimentação*.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e de fácil acesso.

- Oportunidade de crescimento dentro da empresa.

Horário de trabalho:

Segunda a sexta-feira das 9h às 18h

Sábado das 9h às 13h

Se você está pronta para se juntar a um time vencedor e ajudar nossos clientes a alcançarem os resultados dos sonhos, envie seu currículo e venha conquistar grandes resultados com a gente!

*Vem ser nossa estrela!*

title: Analista comercial
description:
ATIVIDADES:

  • Realizar atendimento a leads e clientes via telefone, e-mail e WhatsApp;
  • Qualificar leads e direcioná-los para as etapas adequadas do funil de vendas;
  • Executar follow-ups estratégicos e registrar interações no CRM;
  • Apoiar a equipe de vendas na elaboração e envio de propostas comerciais Acompanhar a atualização do CRM com precisão e regularidade;
  • Auxiliar na análise de métricas comerciais (funil, CAC, taxa de conversão, etc.);
  • Apoiar o onboarding de novos clientes e alinhar demandas com áreas internas como assistência técnica e logística. 


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Conhecimentos em processos comerciais.
  • Capacidade analítica (interpretação de métricas de vendas);
  • Conhecimento e experiência com CRM;
  • Superior em cursos de engenharia, gestão comercial, comercial;
  • Inglês: Básico. 


REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Vivência no segmento metalmecânico;
  • Conhecimento (tabelas dinâmicas, PROCV, gráficos e relatórios);
  • Inglês: Intermediário.

  • Vale refeição;
